wikidot5e:wondrous-items:the-infernal-ma.effectSummary: Artifact command console weighing about 5,500 pounds, operated through 60 levers, 40 dials, 20 switches, and jeweled controls. A supply of silver wire from the machine can connect it to its attuned user like an astral-projection cord; while intact, the remote user may use the machine with effects centered on them and may personally concentrate on its effects. Only effects able to cut an astral-projection silver cord can cut this wire; if cut, feedback instantly kills the user. Machine effects use save DC 14 or the user's spell save DC, whichever is higher. Known summon-control combinations: once per day cast conjure animals or summon lesser demons; once per 7 days cast conjure minor elementals, conjure woodland beings, or summon greater demon; once per month cast conjure elemental or conjure fey. Once per month it can reproduce wish, including normal wish side effects; every wish adds a cumulative 10% malfunction chance. A malfunction disables the machine until 7 days of repairs/reprogramming and 500 gp in parts are completed, after which the malfunction chance resets to 10%. At the end of every long rest of the attuned user, generate 1d4+1 random beneficial and 1d4+1 random detrimental properties from the d100 table below; they last until the end of that user's next long rest, and the DM may secretly roll detrimental properties.
